design: All3 frozen larger-pool directKL fits, all3 matched reconstruction fits, original rank8 PCA and full edit. Diverse five-family/two-format panel query-only; four-format copy panel query/source/both. Add F(donor)-F(receiver) to native L5H5. Reciprocal answer changes, nuisance and identity. Native competence and full effectRMS>=.25 gates for relative margin error. Also KL(full edit||compressed edit). No refitting or seed selection.
limitations: Previously inspected research panels; many diverse task/site effects small, some native tasks fail competence. Rank8 linear representations, no sparse/group/manifold verification. Neither native-to-edit KL nor small error on tiny interventions establishes task causality.
